visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed rotating hero; each slide has a background photo with heading, short text and a CTA overlaid
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width rotating hero (3 slides, fade). Dark photo with text left: white H1, short paragraph, solid blue button. Prev/pause/next arrows and dot pagination centered at bottom.

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per slide: cell 1 = background image (optional), cell 2 = heading (H1 on the first slide, H2 on the rest), paragraph, CTA link

options.label: Caption
options.description: Contained-width news slider: linked article photo with a dark translucent caption bar holding the linked title (no text or CTA); arrows beside the photo, dots below.

reuseGuidance: Use for page-top rotating banners with full-width imagery. For a static hero use `hero`; for contained image+text promos use `carousel-promo`.
usageNotes: Top-of-page hero with 2+ rotating messages. Autoplays (6s, cross-fade) with prev/pause/next and dot controls; autoplay is off when the user prefers reduced motion. A single row renders as a static hero without controls.
